name: OM-1.1-70B-Base
description: Long-term native OM decoder-only Transformer architecture target only. Not for Mac mini training. Requires distributed tensor/pipeline parallelism, sharded optimizer/checkpoints, multi-node fault tolerance and dedicated cluster capacity.
parameter_goal_note: Roughly 70B class architecture target; exact count must be computed by the repository model constructor. Do not launch with current single-process Trainer; it is likely to exhaust memory.
